title: Operating-system command executed from an R string in r — review required
description: system and system2 run a command through the platform shell. A value read from data or a request and pasted into that string is parsed as shell syntax, so a semicolon adds a command. The rule flags the call; whether the string is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Use system2 with explicit arguments and validate them, or call the target through a package API instead of a shell.
limitation: Lexical: matches system and system2 calls; a constant command in a notebook is still reported.
